title: Pip and the Well
skill_description: Practice reading CVC words with short vowels and common digraphs like sh, th, and ll.
author: FunBookies
theme: Water elemental - toad discovers a magical echoing well that speaks wisdom
summary: Pip the toad sits alone until he finds a magical well. When he calls into it, the well echoes back! Pip makes a wish for a pal, and the well becomes his friend.

pip.color: soft teal-green with cream belly (#26A69A body, #E0F2F1 belly)
pip.eyes: large round dark eyes with blue highlight dots, expressive and wondering
pip.distinguishing_feature: one small blue spot on left cheek, like a permanent teardrop
pip.expression_default: open, curious, slightly shy - big wondering eyes
pip.body: small and round, about 3 inches, short stubby legs, no tail, bumpy texture simplified to dots
pip.personality: gentle, thoughtful, loves listening, sometimes lonely, finds joy in small things

character.style_notes: Pip is round and endearing. Simple shapes - body is a squat oval, head blends into body. Bold black outlines. Flat teal color with cream belly. The blue cheek-spot is always visible. Large eyes show emotion clearly. Pip often has head tilted in listening pose.

art_direction.style: Expressive Minimal with dreamy undertones - Mo Willems expressiveness meets Jon Klassen stillness. Bold black outlines, flat color fills, subtle paper texture, lots of empty space for contemplation
art_direction.mood: Gentle wonder, quiet discovery, the joy of being heard, finding a friend in unexpected places

technical.negative_prompts: realistic, 3D render, photograph, complex background, gradient shading, scary, grotesque, text, words, letters

art_direction.avoid: realistic style, detailed textures, scary well/dark imagery, complex backgrounds, text or words

parent_tips.before_reading: Look at the cover. Ask: What animal do you see? What is Pip looking at? Have you ever heard an echo?
parent_tips.during_reading: Notice the digraph words: well, wish, splash. Help your child blend the sounds. When the well 'talks back,' discuss what an echo is!
parent_tips.after_reading: Ask: Why was Pip lonely at first? How did the well become Pip's friend? Have you ever made a wish?

comprehension_questions.question: What was Pip doing at the start?
What happened when Pip talked to the well?
Did Pip get his wish?
comprehension_questions.answer: Yes, the well became his pal

pages.text: Hop, hop, hop! Pip got to the top.

pages.text: It was big! Pip sat on the well.

CLOSE-UP: Pip leaning over the well edge, mouth slightly open as if speaking into it. Large curious eyes. His blue cheek spot visible. Expression is hopeful, questioning. Stone rim visible below his chin. Bold black outlines. NO TEXT.

pages.text: Did it talk? Yes! It did!
pages.image_prompt: CLOSE-UP on Pip's face: Expression of pure astonishment - eyes HUGE, mouth in surprised 'o'. One front foot raised in an 'oh my' gesture. His blue cheek spot prominent. Confused but delighted. Bold black outlines. NO TEXT.

DYNAMIC SHOT: Pip standing UP on his back legs on the well rim, front legs raised, mouth WIDE open, yelling into the well with gusto. Eyes squeezed with effort, body leaning over. Coming out of his shell, being loud and proud. Motion lines suggest his voice going down. Bold black outlines. NO TEXT.

EMOTIONAL MOMENT: Pip listening with eyes closed, soft smile. Gentle blue-white ripples frame his peaceful face. He's hearing his own name spoken back. For a lonely toad, being called by name means something. Tender, not silly. Bold black outlines. NO TEXT.

pages.text: Splash! Drip, drip, drop! Pip got wet!
pages.image_prompt: ACTION SHOT: Pip on the well rim getting splashed by water droplets rising FROM the well! Surprised delight - eyes wide, laughing grin, droplets on his face. His cream belly visible, droplets sparkling. The well is playful, greeting him. Magical and silly. Bold black outlines. NO TEXT.

pages.text: "I wish I had a pal," said Pip.
pages.image_prompt: TENDER CLOSE-UP: Pip (still slightly damp) looking into the well with a softer expression. He's sharing something real - longing and hope in his large eyes. His blue cheek spot more prominent. Intimate composition - just Pip and the dark well opening. Bold black outlines. NO TEXT.

MAGICAL MOMENT: The echo rises, but the ripples form a gentle embrace-like pattern around Pip. The word feels like a promise. Pip surrounded by warm blue-white ripples curving around him protectively. Wonder on his face. Did the well just agree? Bold black outlines. NO TEXT.

pages.text: Pip sat with the well. The well let Pip in.
pages.image_prompt: PEACEFUL SHOT: Pip sitting contentedly on the well rim, bathed in soft blue light rising from the well. Relaxed posture, serene smile. The well's glow envelops him gently, like being welcomed. Sunset colors in sky. Pip has found his friend. Bold black outlines. NO TEXT.

pages.text: Pip got a pal! Did it talk? Yes, it did!
